state:
- Evidence handling is exceptional: S1–S4 are accurately distinguished, and phosphorylated TDP-43 is not conflated with NUP98 phosphorylation. However, the TARDBP-to-NUP98 regulatory bridge remains undefined; specify the allele and test an explicit upstream kinase/phosphatase hypothesis.
- Phosphorylation-resistant rescue would not uniquely establish phosphorylation-dependent loss of pore binding; substitutions could compensate through other structural effects. Add an orthogonal, acute manipulation of actual NUP98 phosphorylation and directly measure its effect on pore association.
- The experiments test the initiating lesion better than the downstream chain. Firing rescue could involve cargos other than TDP-43; independently preserve nuclear TDP-43 and measure its RNA-processing function to test whether its depletion mediates neuronal dysfunction.
